messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: Extra parameter
parts:
Hi Phil,

Could I introduce an extra parameter that does not belong to item parameters and population parameters but used for parameter constraints? I mean, like Mplus, allowing an extra parameter in model constraint:

(Mplus syntax)

MODEL CONSTRAINT:
NEW(z);  # an extra parameter
...            # doing some parameter constraints with item parameters or population parameters


Of course, the "z" parameter is estimated. I wonder if it is possible by using alabama.

Thanks!
